name: What are the primary benefits of investing in water-wise landscaping?
description: Benefits include reduced water bills, lower maintenance, increased property value, and environmental sustainability. It creates a beautiful, resilient landscape

mainEntity.name: What are the primary benefits of investing in water-wise landscaping?

acceptedAnswer.text: Investing in water-wise landscaping offers multiple benefits beyond water conservation. It significantly reduces your water bill due to less irrigation. Maintenance requirements are generally lower, as native and drought-tolerant plants often need less pruning, fertilizing, and pest control. These landscapes enhance property value and aesthetic appeal by creating a beautiful, sustainable outdoor environment that is well-suited to the Southern California climate. They also support local ecosystems by providing habitat for wildlife.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include reduced water bills, lower maintenance, increased property value, and environmental sustainability. It creates a beautiful, resilient landscape.
